lanes.name: specialist_evidence
lanes.purpose: Resolve or strengthen rights, economic, authority, identity and architecture evidence.

lanes.name: historical_body_recovery
lanes.purpose: Recover provenance-bearing historical bodies and lineage without inference-based reconstruction.

quality_invariants: no inferred historical bodies presented as recovered
no terminal disposition by queue pressure
no production capability claim without evidence
failed gates return records to OPEN or HOLD
counting_rule: Queue creation, routing, classification, or documentation scaffolding does not change the 61 qualified / 388 pending baseline. Only exact record receipts that pass the governing gate may change official completion counts.
